description: Trade name 'Ridgeline Drywall' on Summit; damaged door frame

email.subject: Summit - BC-5002 door frame, Room 214
email.body:
Hi,

Your crew's board cart hit the hollow metal frame at Room 214 at Summit and bent the jamb. The frame had to be cut out and replaced.

BC-5002: replace damaged door frame, Room 214, $2,300.00.

Thanks,
Dana Ortiz
Project Manager, Apex Builders
